title: Tianji Fourth Page
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was digesting this shocking truth, a line of blood-red characters appeared at the very bottom of the fourth page—'Number 49 has been marked by Heavenly Dao.' At the same time, a violent fluctuation came from the direction of Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan's aura was rapidly approaching.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji prepared to take Chen Nian away, the ancient inscriptions on the altar suddenly blazed, and the Tianji Record Fragment shuddered violently—that was a reaction it had never shown before. Golden light erupted from the cracks in the fragment, intertwining with the dragon vein power on the altar into an impenetrable net. "Brother..." Chen Nian's voice became blurred in the light, her form starting to become translucent, not dissolving but being pulled by some force to resonate with the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji gripped Chen Nian's hand tightly, his knuckles white from the force: "Don't be afraid, brother's here." He had never shown such determination in front of anyone. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, but with unprecedented gravity: "The fourth page... it awakened on its own. Remember, no matter what you see, don't let go of her hand."

text.content: At the center of the altar, a complete jade tablet rose slowly from the ground, its inscriptions matching the fragments on the Tianji Record perfectly. The moment Chen Ji's gaze touched the jade tablet, the Tianji Record Fragment abruptly turned—the fourth page, silently unfolding. This page was different from the previous three damaged pages; it was a complete golden scroll. On the scroll was a breathtaking chessboard.

dialogue.content: The chessboard, a total of ninety-nine by ninety-nine squares. Each square contained a point of light, some as bright as stars, others dim as dying candles. And in the forty-ninth square, a faintly flickering golden point of light corresponded to the familiar number—49—on the Tianji Record Fragment. Chen Ji's pupils constricted: "This is..."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor it had never shown in thirty thousand years: "The Fate Chess Game... I thought it had long become invalid,没想到..." The scroll continued to unfold, and a piece of sealed history emerged. In ancient times, the Heavenly Court opened once every ten thousand years, selecting the most potential beings from all creatures in the world to supplement the celestial ranks. And the mechanism of this selection was—the Fate Chess Game.

dialogue.content: Just then, a massive eye appeared in the center of the scroll. Its pupil held no sorrow nor joy, only cold judgment. The Heavenly Dao's Eye—it had not truly descended, but regarded this moment through a projection of will. "Number Forty-Nine." The voice did not come from outside, but rang directly in Chen Ji's divine sea, "You are the chosen seed of the Seventh Era."

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness was pulled into a void. All around were endless chessboard squares, and he stood precisely at the center of the forty-ninth square. Above, a sky-covering giant eye gazed down coldly, as if examining an ant. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice rang again: "The rules of the chess game are simple—survive, reach the end. Failed pieces will be eliminated."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, stared directly at the giant eye, and a cold smirk actually appeared at the corner of his mouth: "Eliminated?" His voice echoed in the void, "I would like to know who exactly is playing this chess game." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil slightly contracted, as if seeing this ant properly for the first time. After a long while, its voice rang again, with a hint of playfulness: "Interesting... But you will soon understand the price of questioning the chess game."

text.content: The scene shifted, and the complete eighty-one-square chessboard appeared before Chen Ji. Each square was an abbreviation of a destiny—someone died on the very first square, someone was stabbed in the back by companions at the fortieth square, and those who could reach the end were extremely rare. Mo Xiansheng's heavy voice rang: "From ancient times to now, seven Era Chess Games have been opened. In each era, those who could reach the end... never exceeded three."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly asked: "Where are those who reached the end now?" Mo Xiansheng did not answer, but a line of small characters appeared on the fourth page of the Tianji Record: 'Victors enter the Heavenly Court, the defeated enter reincarnation.' Chen Ji looked at this line, then suddenly laughed lightly: "What fair heavenly judgment. Win and become immortal, lose and reincarnate, either way seems profitable... Unless—"

text.content: Unless what? Chen Ji's smile grew colder: "Unless some pieces don't even qualify for reincarnation." He thought of those geniuses who "accidentally" fell in the middle of the chess game, those candidates who were erased even before leaving a number. The Heavenly Dao's Eye did not deny it, only saying coldly: "In the chess game, one is responsible for one's own life and death."

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, hiding all his edge beneath a calm expression. He slightly bowed toward the Heavenly Dao's Eye, his voice respectful and humble: "The junior understands. Since I am a piece, I should abide by the chess game's rules." The Heavenly Dao's Eye seemed satisfied with his pragmatism, the coldness in its pupil fading somewhat. However, beneath this respectful posture, Chen Ji had already begun rapid calculations—chess game rules, number of participants, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's judgment criteria... every piece of information could become a chip for a comeback later.

choices.visible_cost: Exposing part of the Tianji Record's abilities may trigger stronger suppression

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, his eyes blazing with brilliant light. He stepped forward, his voice like a sword leaving its sheath: "Heavenly Dao?" He laughed coldly, "If I, Chen Ji, am a piece, then this chess game is far too childish." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's pupil contracted sharply, an invisible pressure bearing down like a collapsing mountain. Chen Ji felt his internal organs trembling, yet he forced himself to straighten his spine. His right hand pressed against the Tianji Record Fragment, golden light circulating, actually tearing a crack in that pressure.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his expression shifting from defiant to compliant, yet carrying a hint of unwillingness: "The junior is willing to enter the chess game, but there is one thing unclear—" He changed tack, "In this chess game, are there other forces interfering? For example... certain self-righteous sects?" The Heavenly Dao's Eye was silent for a moment, seemingly examining his intention. The question Chen Ji raised seemed harmless, but in reality he was testing: if Heavenly Dao allowed sect interference in the chess game, then he could borrow strength to strike; if not, he would know his enemies were only within the chessboard.

Chen Nian's form in reality resonated more deeply with the Tianji Record, the mark between her brows becoming increasingly clear. Mo Xiansheng urgently said: "Her being chosen as the 'Lock Key' was no accident—she is the key to opening your forty-ninth square seal!" Before the words finished, new information appeared on the fourth page: 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key has been bound, Number 49 seal release progress—one-third.'

Chen Ji suddenly realized something. He looked down at Chen Nian, the girl's face appearing especially pale in the golden light. "Nian'er, all these years..." Chen Nian smiled weakly: "Brother, I'm fine. The people of the Holy Sect said I was a 'key,' so that was the meaning. As long as I can help brother, it's worth being confined for however long." Chen Ji's fists suddenly clenched, his fingernails deeply embedding into his palms.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji pulled Chen Nian behind him, carefully examining her complexion. The girl's lips had lost all color, yet the mark between her brows was shining even brighter. "Silly girl," Chen Ji murmured softly, his voice carrying tenderness never shown before, "Brother doesn't need you to be anyone's key. You just live well, that's the greatest help to brother." Chen Nian's eyes slightly reddened, yet she stubbornly shook her head.

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the turbulent emotions in his heart, turning to Mo Xiansheng: "What... does this seal seal?" Mo Xiansheng contemplated for a moment, then finally spoke: "It seals your complete permissions as 'Number 49.' The Tianji Record is originally a chess game prop, your fragment is merely the tip of the iceberg. With each release of the seal, you can see another layer of truth—including other pieces' positions, the specific terms of the chess game rules, and..." He paused, "the Heavenly Dao's Eye's judgment patterns."

The Tianji Record fourth page continued to unfold, and a detailed list of rules appeared. Chen Ji scanned each word, his heart gradually sinking to the bottom—the chess game adopted an 'elimination system,' passing each stage required competing with other pieces, and the defeated would not only die, their chance of reincarnation would also be deprived. More cruel was, pieces could hunt each other, and half of the slain's 'Heavenly Fate Value' would transfer to the killer.

Chen Ji suddenly noticed a detail: "Wait, it says 'Heavenly Fate Value can be transferred'... Doesn't that mean killing other pieces is the fastest way to recover Heavenly Fate Value?" Mo Xiansheng sighed: "Correct. This is the cruelest design of the chess game—it makes all pieces each other's hunters. If you don't kill, others will kill you. And every time you use the Tianji Record to foresee the future, you consume Heavenly Fate Value..."

Chen Ji finally understood the terrible nature of his situation. The Tianji Record was his trump card, but each use brought him one step closer to death. And other pieces, especially those geniuses with abundant Heavenly Fate Value, could freely use various abilities to crush him. "So..." he murmured, "I must keep killing people to sustain my own consumption?" Mo Xiansheng was silent for a long while: "Or, find a method to grow stronger without consuming Heavenly Fate Value."

text.content: Chen Ji quickly ran through all known pieces in his mind. Ye Qing was a Demon Path saint who had a secret agreement with him; Su Qingyao had not entered the chess game, but was the only person he could unconditionally trust; even Han Lie, whom he had crushed multiple times... the enemy of my enemy might become my friend. He said in a low voice: "I need to know where the other pieces are now."

text.content: Chen Ji looked at the jade tablet on the altar, suddenly asking: "In the chess game, is there any fortune that can let one grow stronger quickly without consuming Heavenly Fate Value?" Mo Xiansheng contemplated: "There is. On the chessboard there are nine 'Tianji Pavilions' in total, storing the legacies of victors through the ages. More importantly for you—the techniques in the Tianji Pavilions, some can directly act on Heavenly Fate Value itself, rather than consuming it."

text.content: A gleam of sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: "Since it's a chess game, there must be rule exploits." He examined the rule list on the fourth page again, this time even more carefully. Suddenly, he noticed a line of small characters: 'Pieces of the same number can perform 'Fate Binding,' after binding both parties share Heavenly Fate Value, but if one party dies, the other will suffer one-third Heavenly Fate Value backlash.' He murmured: "Is this an exploit... or a trap?"

Just as Chen Ji was digesting this information, a line of blood-red characters suddenly lit up at the very bottom of the Tianji Record fourth page. The characters were twisted and ice-cold, like some ancient curse: 'Number 49 has been activated.' At the same time, thousands of miles away in the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds, a pair of old and turbid eyes suddenly opened. Ling Yuan's lips curled into a cold, sinister smile: "Finally... I've waited for you."

At the same time, within a certain cave dwelling in Xuanwu Sect, a young man emanating scalding aura raised his head. Han Lie, the chess game mark between his brows was pulsing, a resonance created when other pieces activated. "Number 49?" He grinned, eyes full of fighting intent, "That trash? This time, I want to see where he can still hide." He stepped forward, the cave dwelling collapsed with a roar, and his entire person turned into a streak of light, streaking toward Tianqing Sect.

Chen Ji seemed to sense something, raising his head to look toward Tianqing Sect. Mo Xiansheng's heavy voice rang: "Your activation mark has been broadcast by the chess game system. From now on, all pieces and... some existences watching the chess game will know your location." Chen Nian nervously grabbed his sleeve: "Brother, what do we do?" Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed lightly: "Good timing." His eyes held no fear, only cold calculation, "Since they're coming, let them all come. Right... I also want to see just how many mixed fish and dragons are hidden in this chess game."

The Tianji Record fourth page slowly folded up, but in the final moment, another line of small characters appeared: 'Warning: Number 49 has been marked by Heavenly Dao. During the marking period, Heavenly Fate Value consumption increases by 20%, but correspondingly, surviving successfully grants additional rewards.' Chen Ji looked at this line, frowning slightly. The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice rang again, with a hint of mockery: "This is a 'gift' for all pieces. As the only 'trash' piece of this era... you deserve special consideration."

Chen Ji's gaze turned ice-cold. Toward the Heavenly Dao's Eye in the void, he smiled faintly—that smile held no anger, only a kind of chilling calm: "Consideration?" he softly repeated these two words, "Then that's... many thanks." Before the words finished, he had already turned to look at Chen Nian, his tone gentle as if from a different person: "Nian'er, brother will take you home." And in some corner of his heart, a cold thought was forming—Heavenly Dao's Eye, since you treat me as a piece, then let me show you just how big a wave this piece can make.
